name: Cirrus Runners

billing.notes: Flat subscription, not metered: each Cirrus Runner (one concurrency unit) costs $150/month with unlimited minutes. Smaller Linux resource classes use 0.125-0.5 units, XL and GPU use 2 units. Represented as billing.unit "flat": price_usd_per_minute is 0 and each runner's flat_fee gives the monthly cost of one concurrent job of that size. 15% off for an annual commitment or 50% off for non-profits (not applied).

free_tier.notes: 10-day free trial. Not applied in runnerdb prices.

notes: Linux images are not 100% compatible with GitHub-hosted runner images. Jobs can add a "low-priority" label to yield to regular jobs near the concurrency limit.
